units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 11:15">Targ. Job XI, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 21:17">Targ. Lev. XXI, 17</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 35a:14">Bekh. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>הוי מ׳</he> is a blemish in the sense of the law.

<cite ref="Gittin 56a:4">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>דלדידן הוי מ׳ וכ׳</he> which according to our (Jewish) laws is a blemish (unfitting for the altar), but is not so according to their (Roman) ritual; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מוּמִין</he>, <cite ref="M00521"><he>מוּמֵי</he></cite>.
